message: Hi, thanks for working with us. Here is our opening proposal: $7.00 per unit, orders of 500 to 5,000 units, 20% paid at shipment, 50% at receipt and the remaining 30% at inspection. We ship within 30 days with a 3-day grace period. Late shipments get a 1% price cut per day, capped at 10%. Either side can cancel after 30 days, and goods are deemed accepted after 7 days. We're open to discussing details.
